script.onScreen: A mistake is not the end of your return. / Read this if you feel too far.
REFLECTION / Come back, as you are. / Feeling far is not a reason to stay away. The door this ayah describes is open to the one who returns. Begin with a sincere istighfar today.
Return. He forgives. / Share it with someone who needs it

caption:
A mistake does not have to be the end of your return.

Qur'an 39:53 speaks to those who have wronged themselves: do not despair of the mercy of Allah.

Begin with a sincere istighfar today.

Share it with someone who may find it helpful.
